summary:
AEGIS (Autonomous Edge-Guided Intelligent Supervisor) is an offline-first crew health, radiation, and psychological well-being monitoring system built for astronauts on long-duration space missions. Operating entirely without Earth-bound internet connectivity, AEGIS combines a Python/FastAPI telemetry backend, a React/TypeScript mission dashboard, and local AI inference powered by Gemma (gemma 4:e4b) via Ollama.

As human spaceflight extends beyond low Earth orbit to the Moon and Mars, communication blackouts and latency make real-time ground support impossible. AEGIS addresses this challenge by processing physiological biometrics, cognitive performance, and cumulative radiation exposure locally on spacecraft hardware to generate real-time task readiness estimates. Simultaneously, it provides an onboard AI Mind Companion and Reflective Coach that offer confidential stress-management support and schedule insights—strictly isolated from medical fitness-for-duty records and protected by deterministic safety guardrails.

By uniting proactive physical risk detection with private psychological support at the edge, AEGIS safeguards astronaut health, autonomy, and cognitive resilience when Earth is millions of miles away.
details:
AEGIS (Autonomous Edge-Guided Intelligent Supervisor) is an offline-first crew health, radiation, and psychological well-being monitoring system designed for astronauts on long-duration space missions. Operating completely independent of Earth-bound internet connectivity, AEGIS integrates physiological telemetry, environmental radiation tracking, task readiness estimation, and an onboard AI Mind Companion into a unified mission-control and crew interface.

What It Does & How It Works

  • Physiological & Radiation Telemetry: Tracks crew biometrics, sleep quality, cognitive performance, and absorbed radiation doses while separating external reference readings from cumulative crew exposure.
  • Task Readiness Estimation: Evaluates daily astronaut readiness using onboard telemetry to provide actionable mission insights without compromising crew privacy.
  • Offline AI Mind Companion & Reflective Coach: Runs local inference directly on spacecraft hardware, offering astronauts private, conversational stress-management support and daily schedule explanations with deterministic safety guardrails and crisis-escalation notices.
  • Role-Based Operations: Separates astronaut self-monitoring views from flight surgeon/medical officer oversight, ensuring personal psychological chats remain strictly isolated from medical fitness-for-duty evaluations.

Key Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Zero-Latency, Deep-Space Autonomy: Because deep-space missions experience severe communication delays and blackouts with Earth, running AI inference locally ensures uninterrupted decision support and mental health resources 24/7.
  • Proactive Risk Prevention: Early detection of cumulative radiation exposure, fatigue trends, and cognitive decline protects astronaut safety and prevents mission-critical human error.
  • Psychological Resilience: Gives crew members an immediate, non-judgmental sounding board for isolation, homesickness, and interpersonal tension during multi-month missions.

Tools, Languages & Technologies Used

  • AI & Local Inference: Gemma (gemma 4:e4b), Ollama local inference server
  • Backend & Data: Python, FastAPI, SQLite, Pandas, Node.js / TypeScript (Mind Companion service)
  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS
  • Testing & Development Workflow: Pytest, Vitest, Playwright, Git/GitHub, VS Code
  • AI Development Assistants: Gemini, Claude, and Codex (used for architecture design, code generation, debugging, and test validation)

Creativity & Key Design Factors Considered

  • Creativity: Combines clinical-grade mission telemetry with an empathetic, privacy-preserving AI companion—using strict architectural boundaries so an astronaut can speak openly about stress without fear of it altering their operational readiness score.
  • Human & Ethical Guardrails: Designed deterministic safety filters to prevent the AI from impersonating a licensed clinician, diagnosing conditions, or claiming it can automatically alert ground control—instead directing crew to human flight surgeons during urgent disclosures.
  • Offline-First Resilience: Engineered idempotent message queuing, local SQLite/JSON persistence, and networkMode: 'always' query handling so every dashboard module functions seamlessly when completely disconnected from external networks.
